UPTET RESULT 2026 OUT: The Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the result for the Uttar Pradesh Teacher Eligibility Test (UPTET) for Paper 1 and Paper 2 on 26 August 2026. At the Primary Level, 713,648 candidates appeared, out of whom 571,435 candidates qualified, with a pass percentage of 80.07%. At the Upper Primary Level, 1,057,021 candidates appeared, out of whom 759,513 candidates qualified, with a pass percentage of 71.85%. Among the working teachers who appeared for the exam, 93,387 out of 122,405 candidates (76.29%) qualified at the Primary Level. At the Upper Primary Level, 113,384 out of 146,394 working teachers (77.45%) qualified.

Candidates who appeared in the exam can check their qualifying status by visiting the official website of the commission, i.e., upessc.gov.in. Those who qualify the exam will receive the UPTET Eligibility Certificate, which enables them to apply for Primary Teacher (Classes 1 to 5) and Upper Primary Teacher (Classes 6 to 8)recruitments in Uttar Pradesh. The candidates can download the result and keep the printout for future use.

UPTET Result 2026 OUT Official Notice PDF: Click to Check

UPTET Result 2026 Download Link Active at upessc.up.gov.in

The UPTET 2026 Result download link is also provided below. A total of 1,994,661 candidates have appeared in the exam in 60 districts of the state. Such candidates can check their marks by entering their login credentials such as roll number and password. The result is declared in the form of a scorecard that displays the marks obtained in each paper, overall marks, qualifying status, and other important details.

UPTET Result 2026 Direct Link: Click to Download

NOTE: As the UPTET Result 2026 has been declared, the SUPER TET Notification will soon be released by the authority. UPTET qualified candidates can apply for the Super TET Notification 2026.

UPTET Result 2026 Statistics

The exam was held on 02 and 03 July 2026 in two shifts and on 04 July 2026 in one shift. On 05 July 2026, the exam was conducted in five shifts, including three shifts for the Upper Primary Level and two shifts for the Primary Level. The test was conducted at 955 exam centres in Uttar Pradesh. The statistics of the results are mentioned in the table below.

Category Candidates Appeared Candidates Qualified Pass Percentage
Primary Level (Classes 1 to 5) 7,13,648 5,71,435 80.07%
Upper Primary Level (Classes 6 to 8) 10,57,021 7,59,513 71.85%
Working Teachers – Primary Level 1,22,405 93,387 76.29%
Working Teachers – Upper Primary Level 1,46,394 1,13,384 77.45%

upessc.up.gov.in TET Result Out Overview 2026

UP TET is a state level eligibility test conducted to check the eligibility of the candidates for appointment as teachers in primary (Paper 1) and upper primary (Paper 2) schools in the state of Uttar Pradesh. The overview of the exam and results are given below.

Particular Details
Conducting Body Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC)
Exam Name Uttar Pradesh Teacher Eligibility Test (UPTET)
Papers Paper 1 and Paper 2
UPTET Exam Date Two shifts on 02 and 03 July, one shift on 04 July
Exam Level State Level
Advertisement No. 01/2026
Letter No. 1840/48(2026)/Examination/2026-27
UPTET Total Applicants 1,994,661
UPTET Result Date 26th August 2026
Exam Mode Offline
UPTET Result Credentials Roll Number and Date of Birth
UPTET Certificate Validity Lifetime
Official Website upessc.up.gov.in

UPTET Score Card 2026

The result is released in the form of a scorecard. It shows the marks obtained in the respective paper. The scorecard is very important for recruitment of teachers, counselling, and checking documents. Candidates can get their individual scorecard by clicking on the provided link.

How to Download UPTET Result 2026?

Candidates can download their UPTET marks from the official website in just a few minutes. They can follow the below-mentioned steps to download their result and scorecard.

Step 1: Visit the official website of UPESSC.

Step 2: Click on the result link ‘UPTET Result ‘

Step 3: Please enter your 10-digit ‘ Roll Number’ and Password or Date of Birth’ in the format 1 jun 2026 – 01062026)

Step 4: Your marks will appear on your screen

Step 5: Take a printout of the result for further use.

Details Mentioned on UPTET Scorecard 2026

After downloading the result, candidates should carefully verify all the information printed on the scorecard. If any information is incorrect, they should contact the examination authority immediately. The following information will be available on the result document

  • Candidate’s Name
  • Roll Number
  • Registration Number
  • Father’s Name
  • Category
  • Paper Appeared (Paper 1/Paper 2)
  • Marks Obtained
  • Maximum Marks
  • Qualifying Status
  • Examination Year
  • Result Declaration Date

UPTET Qualifying Marks

To qualify the UPTET examination, candidates must secure the minimum qualifying marks as given in the table below:

Category Qualifying Marks Percentage
General / UR 90 out of 150 60%
OBC 82 out of 150 55%
SC 82 out of 150 55%
ST 82 out of 150 55%
EWS 82 out of 150 55%

UPTET Certificate 2026

Those who score the minimum qualifying marks in the exam will be issued a certificate, which will be valid for life. Qualified candidates can download their certificate from the official website of UPESSC. They can also get the UPTET Eligibility Certificate through DigiLocker.

How to Download the UPTET Eligibility Certificate from DigiLocker

The eligibility certificate is available on DigiLocker. Applicants can follow the below steps to get their certificate from DigiLocker:

  1. Open the DigiLocker app on your mobile or go to the DigiLocker website (digilocker.gov.in).
  2. Create an account (if you don’t have one already) or login with your Aadhaar-linked mobile number.
  3. Click on ‘Search Document’ and choose ‘Uttar Pradesh’ as issuing state.
  4. Search for ‘UPTET Certificate’
  5.  Enter your roll number and year of exam.
  6. Click “Get Document” to open and save the certificate.

What After UPTET Result?

A big congratulations to the candidates who have qualified this exam. Many candidates are now wondering about what to do after clearing the exam. They are advised to follow the mentioned points:

  • Download Scorecard: Download your scorecard from the website of the commission and verify all the details.
  • Take Printout: Take multiple print-outs of the certificate
  • Look at the Certificate: Check the official website regularly for UPTET Eligibility Certificate and download it once it is available.
  • Keep an eye out for Recruitment Notices: Candidates should also keep an eye on future teaching vacancies in Uttar Pradesh and the eligibility criteria mentioned in every official notification.
  • Document Verification: Keep your UPTET Scorecard, Eligibility Certificate, Educational Certificates, and Other Required Documents ready for the future recruitment process.

Candidates who were not able to qualify in UPTET 2026 can use their result to know the areas of improvement and start preparing for the next examination.

UPTET 2026 Teacher Recruitment

Those candidates who qualify UPTET can also keep an eye on the upcoming teaching recruitments of Uttar Pradesh. However, each recruitment has different eligibility criteria and candidates are advised to always check the official notification before applying.

  • UP Assistant Teacher Recruitment
  • UP LT Grade Teacher Recruitment
  • Super TET

UPTET Final Answer Key 2026

As of now, the commission has not published any final answer key on its website. In case the final answer key is uploaded by the commission, we will update the same on this page. Applicants are advised to keep track of this page for all the latest updates.

UPTET Result 2026 Live Updates

The UPTET Result 2026 has been released on its official website @tupessc.up.gov.in on 26th August 2026 by the authority. Get direct result download link, steps, dates, answer key, statistics, scorecard PDF, detailed video and all other UPTET result official updates here on these live updates.
